coverage.conclusion: Prior focused persistent Control API, native peer identity/session, helper authorization and extension containment review retained; reviewed source bytes unchanged. RC7 executable ACL correction closes the initial descriptor/ancestor ACL policy gap.

UI exposes manifest/observation/plan hashes and exact actions. Model snapshots project identity, allows confirmation only from awaiting state, fences duplicate/late responses and cancels active transport on disconnect. Server runner recomputes the plan and compares the exact digest, then revalidates before execution.

Manifest admission bounds UTF8 bytes/depth/nodes and rejects aliases/anchors/merge/custom tags; schema decoder rejects unsupported fields. Compose uses a narrow grammar and validates rendered output before success. Control frames reject declared oversize before body allocation and impose deadlines; JSON scanner caps128depth/100000nodes. Helper framing caps8MiB and canonical re-encoding rejects duplicate/unknown fields. Qualification JSON requires byte-for-byte canonical form and validated contract. Apple JSON byte limits/duplicate fields/semantic identities checked; explicit scanner depth remains a hardening follow-up.

Database and sidecars require owned private regular single-link files; ancestor and descriptor ACL policy rejects access grants. Managed connection locks and before/after identity checks protect SQLite opening. Defensive/trusted-schema/load-extension/attachment policy is set and verified. Managed transactions reject nesting, roll back cancellation, surface uncertain outcomes. Replay links subject/key/digest/request and terminal stream transitions atomically.

Prior exact resource ownership/fence/helper mutation review reused only for byte-identical files. Current lifecycle exact-plan check precedes revalidation/execution; desktop cannot supply a substitute execution plan. Existing runtime observations are not alone mutation authority.

Reviewed stage/accept/promotion/cask source and signer/hash bindings remain enforced. Mandatory macOS assertions now exit explicitly; exact-source before/after CI checks and source doctor expectations have regression coverage. Authenticated Linux SDK recipe is unchanged; runtime preparation ordering and static runner guard reviewed. This is source-only evidence, not an installed or signed-artifact claim.
